slides.headline: WARDLEY DROPPED DUBOIS TWICE. DUBOIS STILL WON.
TWO KNOCKDOWNS. ONE COMEBACK.
slides.body: Wardley had Dubois down twice in their first fight. Dubois recovered and stopped him in round eleven.

slides.headline: THE OPENING ROUNDS MATTER.
slides.body: Wardley's pressure creates danger. Dubois needs a disciplined jab and clean exits before he looks for the right hand.

slides.headline: A REMATCH IS A DIFFERENT FIGHT.
slides.body: Can Wardley repeat his early success without taking so much return fire? Can Dubois control range before the exchanges turn wild?

slides.headline: DUBOIS OR WARDLEY?
slides.body: Make your pick in the comments. For the full tactical prediction, follow the link in the AURA Fight Club profile.

slides.headline: IS FUNDORA LOOKING PAST THE MAN IN FRONT OF HIM?
CHAMPION VS UNBEATEN CHALLENGER.
slides.body: Sebastian Fundora: 24-1-1, 16 KOs. Ermal Hadribeaj: 23-0-1, 8 KOs. The WBC super-welterweight championship is at stake.

slides.headline: HEIGHT ISN'T THE WHOLE STORY.
slides.body: Fundora's height and reach are unusual at 154 pounds. But his willingness to exchange can offer Hadribeaj openings.

slides.headline: BOOTS CAN WAIT.
slides.body: Fundora has discussed possible major fights, including Jaron Ennis. Nothing comes next unless he solves Saturday's challenge.
